How Packets Travel the Internet

1. DNS Resolution (Domain to IP)

Computers don't understand domain names like example.com directly. First, a UDP DNS Query packet is sent to a DNS Server to discover the target IP address.

2. TCP 3-Way Handshake

Before transferring data safely, TCP establishes a reliable connection with three packets: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK.

3. Packet Fragmentation & MTU

Large web documents are broken into smaller chunks called packets (governed by Maximum Transmission Unit). They travel through intermediate edge & backbone routers.

4. Packet Loss & Retransmission

If a router drops a packet due to congestion, TCP detects the missing Sequence number and automatically retransmits the lost packet!
